name: Aperture
description: Aperture creates personalized recommendation libraries for your Emby and Jellyfin media server users using OpenAI embeddings and pgvector similarity search. Recommendations appear as virtual libraries in your media server's home screen, with support for both movies and TV series.

paths.name: Aperture Libraries Path
paths.description: Path where Aperture libraries will be stored. Should be inside your existing media server's library path.

paths.name: Media Libraries Path
paths.description: Path to the root of your media library.

paths.name: Backups Path
paths.description: Path where backups will be stored

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for accessing the application

variables.name: Run Migrations on Start
variables.description: Whether to run database migrations on container start

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: Set the Node environment. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal port the application listens on. Not recommended to change.
